description: This file defines the CommandInfo class within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically related to console command scheduling. It encapsulates command strings and associated input parameters, providing getter methods for these properties.

classes.name: CommandInfo
classes.description: A class representing command information for scheduled console commands, including the command string and optional input parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CommandInfo object with a command string and optional ArrayInput object.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command string associated with this CommandInfo instance.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the input parameters as an ArrayInput object or null if none were provided.
